evals.prompt: Ayudame a crear una home de mobile para una aplicación de navegación de vuelos, con un avioncito en estilo cartoon.
evals.expected_output: 3 standalone HTML mockups of a mobile home screen for a flight navigation app, each a distinct visual direction informed by Dribbble research, all sharing the same content, each featuring a cartoon-style airplane, plus an index.html comparison page, research.md and decision.md.
assertions: Produces at least 3 separate option HTML files
Includes an index.html that links/embeds every option for comparison
Includes research.md citing at least 5 concrete reference URLs (dribbble.com or similar)
Includes decision.md recording the chosen and discarded directions and the critics' points
Every option includes an inline SVG cartoon airplane
Every option is designed as a mobile screen (viewport meta and a ~375-430px layout or device frame)
Every option defines its design tokens as CSS custom properties on :root
All options share the same content (same flights/destinations/key numbers appear in each)
Options use visibly different font families or palettes from each other (distinct directions)
No lorem ipsum or placeholder copy in any option
